violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. NO CFM PRESENT AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED PORTIONED RICE IN #10 AT 122F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS INSTRUCTED CFM TO LABEL ALL PORTIONED RICE WITH END POINT/.DISCARD TIME OF 3:00PM. EHS EDUCATED CFM THAT UNIT SHOULD BE TURNED ON PRIOR TO PLACING FOODS FOR HOT HOLDING.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: TOFU AT 59F, CUT RADISH AT 58F, CUT CABBAGE AT 50F IN 2 DWR REF #7.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM STATED ALL FOODS PREPARED THAT MORNING <2 HOURS. CFM INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEES TO MOVE FOOD TO OTHER REFRIGERATOR. CFM WILL PLACE WORK ORDER FOR UNIT AND NO TCS FOODS WILL BE STORED UNTIL REPAIRED.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: MARINATED FISH CAKE, STARCH JELLY MARKED WITH PREP DATE AND TIME.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. EMPLOYEE CONFIRMED THAT DATE ON CONTAINERS WAS DATE PREPARED. EMPLOYEE STATED CONTAINERS TAKEN OUT OF REFRIGERATOR <2 HOURS. EHS ASSISTED IN MARKING PROPER END/DISCARD TIME OF 3:00PM/

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2 DWR refrigerator under cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CFM WILL PLACE WORK ORDER FOR REPAIR.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW FISH ON TOP SHELF ABOVE RTE PREPARED FOODS IN 2 DR UR, OBSERVED RAW SHELL EGGS ON SHELF ABOVE BEVERAGE BOTTLES IN WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EMPLOYEE MOVED RAW FISH TO BOTTOM SHELF OF 2 DR UR. CFM MOVED RAW SHELL EGGS TO OTHER SHELVING UNIT IN WIC ON SHELF ABOVE RAW BEEF. EVERGREEN KOREAN CUISINE (Inspection Date: 04/02/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: COOKED BOK CHOY AT 48F, TOFU AT 51F, KIMCHI AT 51F IN #4 2 DR PREP; SLICED CHEESE AT 55F, TOFU AT 55F, LETTUCE AT 56F IN 2 DWR UNDER COOKLINE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM DISCARDED COOKED BOK CHOY, KIMCHI AND SLICED CHEESE. EHS DISCUSSED WITH CFM THAT UNITS MAY BE IN NEED OF REPAIR. CFM LOWERED THERMOSTAT IN #4 AND WILL NOT STORE TCS FOODS UNTIL 41F OR BELOW IS MAINTAINED. CFM WILL NOT STORE TCS FOOD IN 2 DWR UNDER COOKLINE AND REQUEST SERVICE. TOFU AND LETTUCE MOVED TO #3 M3 1 DR PREP AS THEY WERE IN COOLING STAGES.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2 DWR UNDER COOKLINE OBSERVED AT 63F, #4 2 DR PREP OBSERVED AT 44F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. TCS FOODS FROM UNITS WERE EITHER DISCARDED OR MOVED TO ANOTHER REFRIGERATOR DEPENDING ON PREP TIME. CFM ADJUSTEDTHERMOSTAT FOR #4 2 DR PREP AND WILL MONITOR TEMPERATURE- IF ABLE TO MAINTAIN 41F OR BELOW, TCS FOODS WILL BE RETURNED TO UNIT. CFM WILL PLACE SERVICE CALL FOR 2 DR PREP UNIT.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED GAPS WHERE ELECTRICAL/PLUMBING LINES RUN UP WALL INTO CEILING TILES.
violations.corrective_action: CFM WILL SEAL GAPS.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED ACCUMULATION OF DUST AND DEBRIS AROUND CEILING VENTILATION UNITS.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. CFM WILL HAVE CEILING VENTS CLEANED.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED CONTAINER OF RAW EEL ON TOP SHELF OF #8 ABOVE RTE FOODS (PREPARED SOUPS, SAUCES).
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM MOVED RAW EEL TO BOTTOM OF UNIT. CFM WILL REVIEW PROPER STORAGE ORDER OF RAW PROTEIN IN REFRIGERATION UNITS TO MINIMIZE CROSS CONTAMINATION WITH EMPLOYEES.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: KIMCHI, KIMCHI STEW.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CFM HAD EMPLOYEES DATE MARK FOODS WITH PREPARED DATE.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw beef and raw pork on shelf above cabbage in WIC, raw shell eggs on shelf above prepared containers of sauces in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM had employees reorganize WIC to have raw animal foods stored top to bottom according to cook temperature.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Observed unlabeled spray bottle with cleaner on dish cart.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CFM will have employees label spray bottle with chemical name.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 2 DWR under stovetop.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. CFM placed thermometer in unit.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: various spices at cookline, spices throughout kitchen, bulk containers of starches, sauce bottles.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM had employees label all secondary containers with food name.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage No Contamination
violations.observation: Food stored in a location where it is subject to splash, dust or other contamination as follows: paper towels used for hand drying are being hung above containers of spices used at cookline on prep table.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food where it is not exposed to splash, dust or other contamination. EHS discussed with CFM moving paper towel roll or installing guard (made of durable and cleanable material) to surround spices to prevent splash or moving spices to different location.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wet wiping cloth stored on prep table.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CFM discussed with staff that wet wiping cloths must be stored in bleach sanitizer solution.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: Scissors and tongs used for raw meats observed washed in prep sink with soap and water and returned for service.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EHS discussed with management to sanitize all equipment. Manager present instructed employee to run tongs and scissors through dish machine.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. Interior of ice machine observed with discoloration
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: Broths, kimchi, cooked bean sprouts, and side dishes observed in walk in cooler without date marking, PIC stated items are held for 3-4days.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. Manager found date stickers and discussed with employees to date mark all prepared food items.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: Scissors and tongs for meats observed stored in container of ambient water.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. - utensils taken to dish machine to be washed rinsed and sanitized.
